sources: Indicators paraphrased from FATF typology reports and FIU red-flag guidance; thresholds are demo defaults and must be calibrated per deployer.

indicators.text: Repeated cash deposits just below the reporting threshold
More than one cash deposit on the same day
Cash volume inconsistent with the declared income
Customer questioned the reporting requirement or declined to explain the source of funds

counter_indicators.text: Cash volume is within the declared business turnover
Few deposits fall just below the threshold; larger deposits were reported
A documented seasonal or business explanation exists

indicators.text: Many unrelated inbound senders in a short period
Most inbound value leaves the account within hours
Account activity inconsistent with the customer profile
Fraud recall requests received from sender banks

counter_indicators.text: Outgoing payments go to a documented trade supplier
Activity is within the declared business turnover

typologies.name: Cash volume spike without clear pattern
typologies.short: an unexplained increase in cash activity

indicators.text: Cash credits well above the customer's declared income
Tazama velocity rule fired against the 90-day baseline

counter_indicators.text: Cash volume is within the declared business turnover
A documented seasonal or business explanation exists
Outgoing payments go to a documented trade supplier
